research_rules: Do not infer a current rate from either historical article
Do not choose max(rate*notional,0.15) or rate*notional+0.15 without explicit applicable terms
Do not add exchange/NFA charges to a historically bundled fee quote without billed reconciliation
Do not treat later notice headlines as a latest full fee schedule or apply them to every study contract
scope: Bounded public official Coinbase/CDP/help/assets research. No account, credentials, orders, private API, CTS or repo writes.
